existing_trigger4_lane.title: Trigger 4: WP002 G5 aggregate state projection repair
existing_trigger4_lane.instruction: Re-enter current main and this PR or its exact successor. Do not create a second aggregate-projection branch from this packet.

observed_overlap: PR115 already treats STATE.json as a cache/projection rather than truth authority.
PR115 already checks active-pointer/broad-state consistency and terminal reconciliation binding.
PR115 already handles explicit broader_workpackage_status for scoped acceptance.
PR115 already validates append-only reconciliation chains and keeps runtime/whole-system credit at zero.

residual_review_questions.question: Does current PR115/successor expose a pure deterministic canonical builder that reconstructs the aggregate machine view from granular inputs, rather than only rejecting/manual-repairing stale STATE?
residual_review_questions.accept_if: A source-bound builder plus check mode reproduces the checked-in projection deterministically from admitted granular inputs.
residual_review_questions.falsify_gap_if: Existing exact-current code already does this comprehensively.

residual_review_questions.question: Can machine aggregate state losslessly represent accepted generation N/scope S while generation N+1 is ACTIVE?
residual_review_questions.accept_if: Machine state exposes current_generation/current_generation_state separately from highest_accepted_generation/accepted_scopes or an equivalent typed representation.
residual_review_questions.falsify_gap_if: Existing exact-current schema already preserves both dimensions without scalar ambiguity.

residual_review_questions.question: Is projection identity/freshness bound to projector version/code and a canonical manifest of relevant evidence inputs?
residual_review_questions.accept_if: Projection metadata binds schema/projector identity and canonical input-manifest digest or an equivalently strong deterministic freshness witness.
residual_review_questions.falsify_gap_if: Existing exact-current mechanism already proves semantic projection freshness independent of unrelated repository churn.

residual_review_questions.question: Can WORKPACKAGES.md status markers drift independently from the same machine projection?
residual_review_questions.accept_if: Markers are rendered from or mechanically checked against the same projection result; prose may remain manually maintained.
residual_review_questions.falsify_gap_if: Existing exact-current CI already guarantees the human and machine status views cannot diverge.

recommended_delta_if_gaps_remain: Factor current precedence logic into build_projection(root) or an equivalent pure deterministic projection function.
Provide a canonical --check path; optional explicit --write may materialize the view, but the view never becomes truth authority.
Bind projection schema/projector identity and relevant-input manifest digest.
Represent current generation state separately from historical accepted scope when both coexist.
Add G1 accepted + G2 active, contradictory terminal, input-order permutation, unsupported-schema and direct-edit drift falsifiers.
Render or check human status markers from the same projection result.
Preserve PR115 reconciliation-chain and explicit zero whole-system/runtime credit invariants.
counterhypothesis: PR115's validator-only design may already be sufficient; if exact-current re-entry proves deterministic rebuildability, lossless multi-generation scope, strong freshness binding and human-view consistency, retire this residual delta with no code change.
